items.title: Millionaire Mega Mansion
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Welcome to Millionaire Mega Mansion world! You choose how you want to live life as a millionaire in your giant mansion! Includes super cars that you can drive with your friends!

+ Includes a giant mansion world
+ Drivable cars
+ Great for survival or roleplay

items.title: VIRAL TEENS
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
These teens are going absolutely viral! You are the next big viral online social media superstar!

*Includes 10 fashion skins

items.title: HD MOB DRIP
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
HD mobs skins with trendy drip! Show off to your friends with the HD MOB DRIP skin pack!

+ Includes 5 HD mob skins

items.title: Mob School
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
With their brand new uniforms, these mobs are ready to dive into high school life!

- 8 skins!

This set includes the following:

- Creeper
- Enderman
- Zombie
- Skeleton
- Pigman
- Pig
- Spider
- Slime

items.title: Badlands Village
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Overtales Studio presents: Badlands Village! It's time to explore this barren village and have a simple lifestyle like growing crops, breeding animals. Challenge your friend in the training ground and find the strongest. What are you waiting for!?

- Roleplay
- Survival spawn
- Licensed by Overtales Studio and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Snowy Hill Castle
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Overtales Studio presents: Snowy Hill Castle! Have you always dreamed of living in a luxurious castle? This is what you are looking for!! A great castle in the midst of a secret valley.

- Survival facilities.
- Including a basement.
- Hidden things waiting for you to explore!
- Survival spawn.
- Licensed by Overtales Studio and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Mob Hats
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Mob Hats

Would you like to stay in a flock of sheep? It's sure to be a lot of fun kidding your friends when they can't see you because you're in a flock of sheep. With this package, you can carry any mob on your head.

+ 10 different skins
+ Mobs
+ Hats
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Emoji Teens
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Are you in a bad mood today? Or overjoyed? Maybe even in love, or just have to laugh? Then this package should be just right for you about your feelings
express in Minecraft. Be free and show everyone what you feel.

+ 10 different skins
+ Happy emoji's
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Astronaut Life
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Astronaut life

Do you feel like you belong in the universe? Do you want to know more than just one planet? Your journey begins now, with different Astronaut suits. Live your dream in the Galaxy.

+ 10 different skins
+ Space station astronaut
+ Mars astronaut
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Cute Mobs
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Tired of Steve? Do you keep seeing the cute sheep or the cows or even the cats? Now be such a mob yourself and feel free in your own world.

+ 10 different skins
+ Cute
+ Mobs
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Luxury Mansion
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
A millionaire's life awaits you here! Sit back and relax, or adventure around and look at the beautiful gardens! Explore this grand mansion and enjoy living in the lap of luxury.

- Custom furniture models to interact with
- 80+ furniture style options!
- Perfect for roleplaying with friends
- Licensed by Xenon Design and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Anime Pets
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Get your very own bright and wonderful anime pet skin!
One free skin!

items.title: Flannel
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: Staying warm as you travel through the cold winter biomes is essential. These flannel skins will make sure you are dressed for the coldest weather. Grab your friends and grab your coat we are headed to a winter wonderland!

items.title: Dressage Riders
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: Now that you have tamed that wild horse, it’s time to show off what it can do, and don’t forget to dress the part. Be the teen superstar for the judges riding your equestrian steed. Then take to the open world with the wind in your hair.

items.title: Bunny Operation
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
The great operation begins with the colorful rabbit agents and their tactical teams. Enjoy fighting with the creatures and saving the world in furry form! 

- Two totally free skins
- Fourteen Skins 
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Experienced Miners
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
New to mining, want help? Here are 10 of our most experienced miners to make your mining experience more enjoyable.

- Ten skins!
- One skin totally free!
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Summer Styles
items.creator: Box Build
items.description:
Summer is here! Dress in style and have fun on these hot days taking a dip on the beach or relaxing watching the sea with your friends with these special aspects!

+ 12 Unique Skins.
+ Perfect for summer.

Created by Sundae Creations and Published by Kuboc Studios.

items.title: Millionaire Jungle Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Congrats on buying your dream millionaire jungle mansion! We've already moved your furniture, cars, and helicopter onto your new property. Be free of city life and decorate your new world of luxury! Enjoy living in your new mansion and fly your helicopter into the sky!

+ Modern millionaire mansion
+ Furniture with easy to use tools
+ Vehicles
+ Rich life roleplay

items.title: Dj Squad
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
The fresh drinks are here, and the club is teeming with life! Try all the tastes and choose your favorite one. All of your friends are enjoying their summer to its fullest, so why wouldn't you? School is over, and you have a lot of free time, choose with whom you're going to spend it!

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 stylish skins
+ By Team Visionary
